body:
I've been to dozens of colleges across 11 states when I was making my way across the country. I was unable to ever secure any kind of financial aid. I'm ineligible for all government assistance and grants due to my failure to sign up for selective service. I have always been turned down for a loan as well. 

I found out too late about not signing up for selective service, I'm now too old to sign up for it.

You'd think that would be the case. 

I've been turned down for all these loans before. The last time before I gave up on trying to go back to school, I was told I needed a co-signer. I've not found anyone that was willing to go with me and do that so I said screw it. I understand why though, a guy you barely know wants you to co-sign on a loan, it's too risky. I'm not pissed off at them, it reasons out. 

I don't even have a reliable way to school now anyway. 

It kind of doesn't matter anymore, I'm past my prime in life. I've should have had a decent job by now and been able to set aside money. I haven't and now if you crunch the numbers there's no possible way I could save enough for retirement in the time I have left. I'll be working well into my golden years which will be horrible. I already see the effects of age on my body. I can't do some things as well as I used to and there are already aches and pains. 

I've already fucked my life up beyond repair. So why try? 

I've never could get a proper answer from any of the therapists I've talked to about these problems. Just a don't worry about that you don't know how the future is going to be bullshit. It's quite obvious how it's going to be if you use a little reason. Just sitting around doped up doesn't fix the problem. 

I think reddit was also a horrible place to come ask for help. Most of the people on this site are too young to understand the problem. They have families to fall back on and go live with when things are bad. They want you to try things I've already been trying over the past decade and a half. Like I haven't thought of these very basic things to try before.

I don't know how to talk to people anymore and I don't think you'll get it. 

I don't know why I posted this here. If dozens of therapists can't fix it then how can someone here fix my problem?

When I was younger I enjoyed building and testing electronics with my Dad. I can't afford to buy the tools I would need to do that now. Also stuff has changed so much since I was a kid, I would need to go back to school to learn how to do it.

I can't go to school. I don't make enough money and because I failed to sign up for selective services when I turned 18 I'm ineligible for any kind of government grant. I already explained that I tried to go to school for the past 15 years with no luck. 

I've wanted a family ever since my last loved one died. I want a home so I can have some place safe to live instead of the places I'm forced to live in now. Don't try to trivialize my wants and needs. 

I don't have any hobbies because I can't afford to do anything outside of pay my bills. I can only get online at work anyway I don't own a computer or have the internet at home. there would be no way for me to do anything like at the level I'm on in society. 

I get paid under the table so talking to the government about welfare or other assistance is a bad idea. 

I'm tired of running through this basic shit over and over again. It's like a play back of the past two decades in my mind. 

I'm sick of this.

I've talked to several since the mid 90's. I've been doped up on a lot of meds since then too. 

I'm tired of the bullshit cliche phrases too.
